entries.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Single transparent-background raster game asset for this cozy Korean farm game. Match reference style: soft dimensional hand-painted cartoon shading, warm brown delicate contours, cream and natural colors, readable at 48px. Clean true transparent alpha; full subject visible, centered, approximately 8% transparent margin. No text, letters, UI, watermark, border, checkerboard, ground scene, or floating sparkles. Primary request: a small charming weaving workshop building. The apiary reference is ONLY for building camera angle, rendering, scale and wooden construction, not its beehives. Orthographic front view with a slightly visible roof top, NOT a diagonal isometric view. Wooden cottage with a muted sage-green tiled roof, cream cloth awning, an open front displaying one wooden loom and a few ivory yarn spools, a simple woven-cloth emblem without lettering. Compact broad footprint, base near bottom. A stationary building for a 2-by-1 farm footprint.
